name: Connecting Ridge / Site 001
source: Kumari et al., Planetary Science Journal (2022); Site 001 89.45 S, 137.31 W
note: Representative published point, not an approved landing zone
context: One of NASA's 13 Artemis III candidate regions in 2022 (Connecting Ridge); not on the 2024 shortlist of nine.

name: Shackleton Rim / Site 004
source: Kumari et al., Planetary Science Journal (2022); Site 004 89.78 S, 155.73 W
note: Representative published point, not an approved landing zone
representative_point_note: Moved 54 m from the published point (89.78 S, 155.73 W) to the highest 5 m LOLA cell within 100 m (NASA's landing-site radius). The published point sits in a hollow 10.5 m below this crest, where nearby ground blocks the Sun and Earth in every direction.
context: Study site on the rim of Shackleton crater, from Kumari et al. (2022).
